No stronger invariant conflicted with the literal spec: this is a pure net-new addition, the target capability was independently confirmed correct and already-served-elsewhere-safe (no shared code path modified), and no sibling alias in the same file references bodha_pratijna_get or query_pratijna. One process incident during the session, fully contained and disclosed for transparency: this repo's .git is shared across concurrent worktrees for other trains in the same overnight campaign, which makes `git stash` a GLOBAL, cross-train stack, not private to one worktree -- a transient `git stash pop` (used only to toggle red/green test verification) picked up a concurrent train's in-flight stash on the shared CAMPAIGN_COORDINATION.md coordination file and produced a merge conflict on that one file. No F-67 target file (register_p1_aliases.ts, the new test file) was affected -- both were verified intact and conflict-marker-free throughout. The conflicted coordination file was restored to HEAD (git checkout HEAD -- <file>) without dropping or altering any other train's stash entry (stash list count unchanged at 7, entries unmodified). Only the two intended files were ever staged/committed/pushed. Recommend as a campaign-hygiene note: avoid `git stash` in any worktree that shares .git with concurrent trains -- use a scratch commit + reset, or a separate clone, for any red/green toggling that needs to touch tracked-file state.
